pooled_caveat: A mixed opposition-and-authority cluster, not one sovereignty policy. Domestic rights and social-program disputes coexist with international issues.
pooled_summary: Claims reject or criticize policies, administrations, or governing authority across several subjects. Examples oppose disenfranchisement, asserted presidential powers, international emissions agreements, U.N. Agenda 21, police training exchanges, or proposed Medicaid and SNAP changes.
qualification: Source-bound assistant synthesis of bundle-diverse examples, not independent human certification or an exhaustive stance classification. Statements describe the observed documents across years, not every member's beliefs or a current consensus.
